profile_text.body:
SpaceX, legally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, describes itself as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. The company's site text does not mention AI products.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Starbase, Texas. Its ticker is SPCX and its SEC CIK number is 0001181412. It also uses the alias SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A.

The company has a Texas law exposure count of 126.
